newsitem.title: UK: MMI "disappointed" at DLA cobalt tender award. [CORRECTED 12:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: MMI "disappointed" at DLA cobalt tender award. [CORRECTED 12:40 GMT]

text.p: Metal Resources Group Ltd, known as MMI, expressed disappointment over the U.S. Defence Logistics Agency (DLA) cobalt tender award.
"We note that out of four grades of cobalt being tendered the DLA awarded material against only the two lowest grades," MMI said in a statement.
"Despite bidding for a total of 488,418 lbs cobalt MMI was not successful and awards were made for a total of 200,806 lbs cobalt to another party."
"We are disappointed that the DLA awarded 54,492 lbs of 99.05 percent cobalt at $19.01 a lb to a party and declined MMI's bid for the same item at $19.78 a lb due to a technicality," it said.
On Wednesday, the DLA said it sold a total of 200,806 lbs of cobalt for an average $19.47/lb. Glencore Ltd of Stamford Conn was the sole successful recipient, the DLA said.

The DLA received bids on Monday for a total of 999,537 (corrects from 99,537) lbs of contained cobalt, but several bidders failed to comply with the terms and conditions and were ineligible for awards, the DLA said.
